title: Q35 (Generalüberholt)
description: GOLD STANDARD: Benutzerdefinierte Seidenmembrantreiber reproduzieren Musik präzise über einen größeren Frequenzbereich und minimieren Verzerrungen, um kristallklaren Sound zu garantieren, der sowohl als Hi-Res Audio als auch Hi-Res Audio Wireless ausgezeichnet ist. description: Alles verbunden: 10-in-1 mit HDMI 2.1, DisplayPort 1.4, 100W PD-IN für bis zu 80W Ladeleistung, USB-C 10Gbit/s, USB-A 10Gbit/s, 2× USB-A 5Gbit/s, Gigabit-Ethernet sowie SD-/microSD-3.0-Slots. title: Anker Nano USB-C Hub (8-in-1, Dual Display)
description: Versatile 8-in-1 Connectivity: Equipped with a USB-C upstream port with up to 85W output and 10 Gbps data transfer, a USB-C PD IN port with up to 100W input, a USB-C data port (10 Gbps), two USB-A data ports (each 10 Gbps), two HDMI ports for up to 4K@60Hz, as well as SD/TF 3.0 card slots with transfer speeds of up to 104 MB/s. Dual display for Windows: Expand your workspace with razor-sharp 4K@60Hz on up to two external monitors – ideal for multitasking, editing, and more. Supports up to dual 4K@60Hz if the USB-C port of the host device supports DP 1.4 with DSC 3:1. (Note: Under macOS, all external monitors reflect the same content. Fast charging for laptops: Supports up to 85W pass-through charging for your laptop via a 100W PD input. (Note: 15W are reserved for operation of the hub. A 100W PD charger and corresponding cable are required to reach the full 85W and are not included.) Compatibility: Supports fully functional USB-C, USB4 and Thunderbolt connections. Compatible with Windows 10/11, ChromeOS as well as laptops with support for DP Alt Mode and Power Delivery. (Note: On macOS, both external monitors show the same content. This device is not compatible with Linux.)
